text: Sprinkler pipe burst, water flowing on the 6th floor, 363 Sam Houston Pky, Houston.

out.briefing:
PRIMESIGHT | SPRINKLER WATER-FLOW / FLOODING | FLOOR 6
Northbelt - 363 Sam Houston Pky, Houston, TX
SPRINKLERS: yes, wet | BELOW: ~51 people on floors 1-5 (water runs down); possible hospice on fl 5 (Resolurions Hospice) and fl 3 (Gaspy Hospice) (from name only)
ON FLOOR: Unknown tenant (ste 600); Dream Counseling Center (ste 605, possible clients in session, from name only); Tax Services Of Houston LLC (ste 610); H5 Strategic Alliances (ste 615); The Count It All Joy Tax Group (ste 640); Crystal CoWorks (ste 660, 4536 sf, largest suite, possible high occupancy and IT equipment, from name only)
PROPERTY MGR: Realty.com 5559806802 (text drafted asking them to meet crew with riser/shutoff access, not sent yet)
BUILDING: 20 stories | built 1981 | steel frame | ELEVATORS: 7 passenger, 1 freight
OPEN LOT for staging ~562 m SW (aerial search, verify)
INSIDE: 3D scan of this floor | 12 scan points | exit signs at 10, pull stations at 5, no extinguishers seen
WALK FROM SCAN START (not the entry or lobby): exit sign within ~4 m, far end ~17 m
NOT KNOWN: stair locations, sprinkler riser and shutoff locations, generator, building engineer contact
SCAN: https://my.matterport.com/show/?m=Fv5Q2P8Kmsf

texts.text: Fire Dept: sprinkler pipe burst, water flowing on floor 6 at 363 Sam Houston Pky. Please meet the fire crew on arrival with sprinkler riser/shutoff access and keys.

tenant_flags.risk: Possible vulnerable occupants directly below the leak
tenant_flags.why: (from name only) A hospice name suggests patients or medically fragile visitors may be present, though it could be an admin office. Check this floor first, since water will reach it before the lower floors.

tenant_flags.risk: High occupancy on the leak floor
tenant_flags.why: (from name only) At 4,536 sq ft this is the largest suite on the floor, and the coworking name suggests many people plus lots of shared IT and electrical equipment at risk from water.

tenant_flags.risk: Possible vulnerable occupants in the water's path
tenant_flags.why: (from name only) A hospice name suggests patients or fragile visitors may be present. Water may reach this floor as it spreads down through floors 5 and 4.

tenant_flags.why: (from name only) A counseling center may have clients in session who are distressed and need a calm, guided evacuation from the wet floor.
